posts.text: Just over a year ago I wrote this little article. I detailed how a certain a stock checked every box to go viral as per Robert Shiller’s book, Narrative Economics. I expect we are about to begin the next leg up of its popularity takes off. The narrative is unparalleled and I expect the stock performance to be as well. They delivery on USA EPA, EU Reach and UK environment approvals to produce and sell. They just announced a major gas plant deal so they can ramp up production. Capex payback is unparalleled in the material / commodity space. It appears they’ve just filed for a meeting to approve redomiciling to become a USA Texas based company. This is a key piece of the puzzle to earn major US DOW/Military contracts as well as DOE related deals. NASDAQ listing shouldn’t be too much longer and that will put them on the world stage as an emerging leader in the nanotech nanomaterial space. Pure Turbostratic Fractal Graphene is a revolutionary wonder material. Discovered by national professor of the year Dr Sorensen. I think he will get a Nobel prize in due course. $hg $hgraf has the patented process as well as key down stream patents that will enable dramatic improvements in everything we make. People like myself became shareholders not just for the potential financial gains. We want to see this company succeed. We can reduce plastic use by 30% globally by adding their graphene. We can make it safer for use and it’s can be recycled better. The energy savings from using their graphene will prove to be dramatic. I expect at least 20% reduction in energy needed to operate nearly anything. Plus products we make will last 2-3x longer. The EROEI is again unparalleled. In food grade plastics it should be made mandatory for all the reasons above. Saves energy, recycling and improves human and environment health.
